one_liner: Identify churn risk and stay close to users at scale
description:
Minro helps companies stay close to their users as they scale.

Today, most startups have thousands of product events flowing through tools like PostHog, but still have no real understanding of who their users actually are, which users are quietly about to churn, or what outreach actually brings them back. Founders care deeply about their users, but staying close to them becomes operationally impossible very quickly.

Minro plugs directly into a company’s analytics stack and turns product activity into living customer intelligence. We enrich every user with context like their company, role

name: Rovr
one_liner: AI FDE Engine that runs your engineering workflows
description: Rovr streamlines engineering operations by automating intake, triage, routing, and cross-team coordination. It replaces internal forms, manual Slack triage, and scattered docs with an AI front desk that understands requests, assigns owners, updates context, and posts status changes directly into Slack. Rovr’s built-in ops CRM gives teams a single system of record for eng requests — from tooling access to platform incidents to dev-infra workflows — reducing operational drag across the entire org.

name: Narrative
one_liner: AI-Powered Sports Highlights
description: Narrative automates the creation and distribution of high-quality sports highlight videos for broadcasters, teams, and leagues.

name: Nerviom
one_liner: AI Autopilot for Infrastructure Permitting
description:
Infrastructure projects like data centers, factories, and energy facilities require navigating hundreds of permits and regulatory approvals before construction can begin. 

Today this process is handled through consultants, spreadsheets, and thousands of pages of documentation, adding years to project timelines and millions in consulting costs.

We are building an AI autopilot to automate infrastructure permitting and regulatory compliance. 

Our goal is to significantly reduce the time and cost required to get infrastructure projects approved and built.

name: Kashikoi
one_liner: Simulation Engine for Benchmarking AI Products
description: Kashikoi is a simulation engine to benchmark AI agents. We generate CPU friendly world models that autonomously interview agents and generate deep behavioral assessments. We built a similar technology at Moveworks which was used to ship 250+ enterprise agents to customers daily.

name: Clarm
one_liner: Build governed AI agents on your own data, without code
description: Clarm Atlas 10xes productivity for non-technical operators in high-trust, regulated teams - banks, healthcare, insurance, publicly listed companies - by letting them build their own, fully governed AI agents. Teams build agents on their own approved data: every answer cites its source, all primitives are deterministic and highly governable, every action is logged for audit, and you bring your own AI model.

name: Clidey
one_liner: Turn scattered data into one platform for decision-making
description:
WhoDB is an open-source platform for modeling organizations and running decisions on top of their data.

It lets teams define their core entities (customers, accounts, assets, workflows), the relationships between them, and the rules and objectives that govern how decisions should be made. WhoDB continuously ingests operational data and keeps this model up to date in real time.

Instead of building dashboards, writing ad-hoc queries, or maintaining scattered business logic, teams express decisions declaratively—what should happen, under what conditions, and with what constraints. WhoDB eva

name: Vassar Robotics
one_liner: Open-source semi-humanoid dev kit → home data → autonomy → 20h/wk
description: We build home humanoids the practical way—an open, mass-produced developer kit powering a real-home teleop data flywheel to autonomy, giving families back 20 hours/week.

name: StarSling
one_liner: Self-Driving CI
description: Fast GitHub Actions runners with AI agents that continuously improve your CI to make it up to 6x faster and 13x cheaper.

name: Fuchsia
one_liner: Vanta for hardware
description: Fuchsia handles hardware certification and testing so great products can get to markets faster. AI agents keep our work accurate, timely, and fully traceable for every stakeholder.

name: Saffron
one_liner: Helping your company find 10x engineers.
description:
Saffron allows companies to quickly evaluate how well software engineers use AI to code. 

The way engineers write code has fundamentally changed, but the way companies evaluate them hasn't. Saffron gives teams full visibility into how candidates use AI agents to build, debug, and ship real features on an actual codebase. 

Saffron was founded by Robert Chondro (formerly MIT and Jane Street), Jerry Yao (Stanford and Jane Street), and Kazuma Choji (Harvey Mudd, published in NeurIPS and ICML), and is backed by Y Combinator (P26) and Afore Capital.

name: shotwell.ai
one_liner: The Observability Layer for Robotics
description: Robotics companies send Shotwell their video data and we detect failures. We do this for both their training data and for their deployments. We've developed models that can automatically produce these annotations with near-instant turnaround time.

name: Prototyping.io
one_liner: Autonomous manufacturing for mechanical parts
description: Prototyping.io turns CAD designs into real mechanical parts through an AI-driven manufacturing system. We analyze designs for manufacturability and automate production workflows to deliver high-quality parts faster and at lower cost.

name: Ardent
one_liner: Database sandboxes for Agents
description: Clone any postgres DB regardless of size in 6s so agents can test their work

name: YouArt
one_liner: Patreon for AI Originals
description: YouArt helps storytellers create AI originals using our industry-leading video agent, launch their original concepts, get funded directly by early fans, and earn from their audience.

name: Clawvisor
one_liner: The Authorization Layer for AI Agents
description: Clawvisor lets AI agents use apps like Gmail, Slack, and Google Drive without going rogue or ever seeing your credentials. You approve tasks once. Clawvisor enforces them on every request.

name: Denormalized
one_liner: serverless platform for real-time data
description: Denormalized is a serverless real-time data platform that allows users to query data quickly while eliminating the need to manage complex infrastructure. It enhances developer productivity by automating schema inference from sample data and simplifying data stream creation allowing engineers to go from idea to production fast. Denormalized supports SQL for data transformations without needing complex stream processing systems like Flink.
